measured_contract.definition: semantic_version is TUNING.semantic_version (operation semantics); candidate_contract_version is TUNING.candidate_contract_version (candidate enumeration/eligibility, not a candidate index); config_schema_version is TUNING.config_schema_version (serialized config). Historical measured dirty sources are not identified by the current definition.

included_fields: case ID, shape, corpus, dtype, kind and measurement_context
per-phase two-sided raw samples and medians, ratio, cache and timing mode
original block order, sample ranges, monotonic start/end per block
per-side pre/post output and amplitude checks and input restoration
per-case parity, closed, correctness/graph/live-mutation summary and counts
not_a_full_lifecycle_export: No raw lifecycle bindings, capture or allocator addresses, mutation input tensors, full mutation checks/amplitudes or detailed memory stats.

Original logs, process observations, wall-clock epochs, untracked inventory and complete selection/bundles/records are not published in this repository; full lifecycle gates cannot be independently replayed.
export.ratio_direction: b12x median / DeepGEMM median (lower is better)
export.threshold_definition: Every required phase of every case must have ratio <=1.01, not only the aggregate geomean. A paired phase has one side record per arm; a confirmation is a case with both additional paired phases. See ../grouped-fp8.md for raw field definitions.

measurement_context_definition: File-local context-1 joins each companion case to the environment observations below and its monotonic clock domain. It is not a task address or source identity. File line order is not timing order; clocks cannot be compared across contexts or collections.
monitoring_limits: monitor_observations and monitor_conflicts retain original observation/conflict counts. Monitoring method and coverage are not published; zero conflicts does not prove continuous exclusivity or absence of interference. exclusive_visibility:null means unknown/not provided, not an exclusive-device verdict.

context-1.declared_untracked_description: Additional inputs, including experimental directories, were present but are not published; the exact measured tree cannot be reconstructed.

gpu.model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
gpu.throttle_reason: not recorded (do not infer from P-state/clock)

source_repositories_coordinate_system: Paths are relative to the historical external multi-repository workspace, not this b12x checkout; '.' is the external harness repository. Revisions are repository Git bases, not exact dirty-source revisions.
evidence_availability: Companion raw timings and selected correctness summaries are published. Exact dirty/untracked sources, complete logs and lifecycle records are not. The external harness/corpus/formal drivers have no public fetch entry here and are not provided by this repository; these paired measurements cannot be reproduced from this repository alone.
hardware_identity: gpu-1 is run-local. The same pseudonym in another collection does not establish cross-collection card identity. Snapshot clocks do not establish sustained clocks or absence of throttling.

case_memory_scope.interpretation: Whole-case measurements including DeepGEMM and b12x, input preparation, oracle, and timing; NOT a b12x workspace metric.

version_notes.recorded_during_preparation: Preparation checks report CUDA runtime 13.0, Python 3.12.14 and torch 2.14.0+cu130; driver/runtime observations are separate. nvcc/CUTLASS DSL/triton versions were not individually recorded.

boundaries: TUNING.semantic_version 4, candidate_contract_version 8: decode 446 only; semantic-3 prefill/decode uses different dirty sources and must not be combined as same-source 819
not a semantic-4 full matrix, whole-upstream-suite, SM121 or EP1/EP8 scaling qualification
Earlier failed performance attempts remain failures and are excluded from passing phases; complete failure records are not published.
